title: 第3章 第一次模拟结束第4章 熊孩子叶明月
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【一天夜晚，你正在修习憾山拳，一位黑衣人出现在你的房间内，直到你修习完准备修习一会的时候才发现身边有人，看着此人的穿着，内心惊疑的同时，脸上不动声色的询问黑衣人的目的。
【黑衣人告诉你，他有一个传承秘境，需要你这样高悟性还处于淬体境之人才能进入，此次他路过丰元城听闻了你的事情便过来找你，想要带你走，并表示不是跟你商量，是来通知你的。
【面对这种情况，请做出你的选择。
【选择一：乖乖的听从黑衣人的话，毫不反抗的跟随他离开元丰城，前往传承秘境。
【选择二：拒绝黑衣人，表示自己哪也不想去，只想留在叶家。
【选择三：这装扮明显就不是个好人，大声呼救，在周围引发一些战斗波动，吸引叶家强者过来弄死黑衣人。
“选择吗？既然黑衣人说了是想强制带自己走，第二个选项明显是不能用了，至于选项三，他能悄无声息的潜入叶家找到自己房间不被人发现，很明显是有实力的，叶家不好说有没有能压制黑衣人的强者，但呼救这条路显然行不通，实力差距太大，黑衣人可在自己应激之时强行带走自己。”
犹豫了片刻，心里有了决定。
【系统，选择选项一，跟随黑衣人前往传承秘境。
【经过一番短暂的思考，你选择跟随黑衣人前往传承秘境，在你看来只是模拟而已，就算死去也是为你探路，也许真能找到帮助你提升根骨的办法。
即使此次黑衣人不出现，不久你也打算出门寻找解决办法。
【离开丰元城后，你被裹挟着前往未知的地方。
离开丰元城的第三天，你与黑衣人正准备前往下一个城池休整。
突然，你感觉天空一黑，只感觉到有一阵金色虚影向你袭来，你来不及躲避，你死了。
【模拟结束，综合评分：25】
【你一生都在刻苦修炼，明知根骨低劣仍然坚定不移，作为一个普通人来说，你的信念值得称赞，但毫无用处，因黑衣人冯缺与章宏的战斗波动而死亡，如同一个蝼蚁。
而以穿越者的身份来说，你也可称为穿越者之耻。
【请从以下选项中选择奖励。
【选项一：境界提升一重，消耗3积分，可重复选择，随着境界不同消耗积分不同。
【选项二：憾山拳提升至初窥门径，消耗5积分，可重复选择。
content_en:
[One night, you were practicing Hanshan Quan, and a man in black appeared in your room. It wasn't until you finished practicing that you were about to practice for a while that you realized there was someone beside you. You looked at the person's clothes, and while you were surprised in your heart, you asked the man in black's purpose calmly.
[The man in black tells you that he has a secret realm of inheritance, which requires a person with high understanding and still in the body tempering realm like you to enter. This time he passed by Fengyuan City and heard about you, so he came to find you and wanted to take you away. He said that he was not here to discuss with you, but to inform you.
[Faced with this situation, please make your choice.
[Choice 1: Obey the man in black and follow him out of Yuanfeng City to the secret realm of inheritance without any resistance.
[Option 2: Reject the man in black, saying that he doesn’t want to go anywhere and just wants to stay in the Ye family.
[Choice 3: He is obviously not a good person in this costume. He shouts for help, causing some fighting fluctuations in the surroundings, attracting strong men from the Ye family to come over and kill the man in black.
"Do you have a choice? Since the man in black said he wanted to forcefully take him away, the second option is obviously not available. As for option three, he can sneak into the Ye family quietly and find his room without being discovered. He is obviously powerful. It is hard to say whether the Ye family has strong people who can suppress the man in black, but calling for help is obviously not feasible. The difference in strength is too big. The man in black can take him away by force when he is stressed."
After hesitating for a moment, he made a decision in his mind.
[System, choose option one and follow the man in black to the secret realm of inheritance.
[After a brief thought, you chose to follow the man in black to the secret realm of inheritance. In your opinion, it is just a simulation. Even if you die, I will explore the way for you. Maybe you can really find a way to help you improve your bones.
Even if the man in black does not appear this time, you will soon be planning to go out and find a solution.
[After leaving Fengyuan City, you were taken to an unknown place.
On the third day after leaving Fengyuan City, you and the man in black are preparing to head to the next city to rest.
Suddenly, you feel that the sky turns dark, and you only feel a golden shadow coming towards you. You have no time to escape, and you die.
[Simulation ends, overall score: 25]
[You have been practicing hard all your life, knowing that your roots are inferior but still unswerving. As an ordinary person, your belief is commendable, but it is useless. You died due to the fluctuation of the battle between Feng Que and Zhang Hong, the man in black, like an ant.
And as a time traveler, you can also be called the shame of a time traveler.
[Please select a reward from the options below.
[Option 1: Upgrading the realm by one level consumes 3 points. It can be selected repeatedly. The points consumed vary with the realm.
[Option 2: Shanshan Fist is upgraded to the first glimpse of the door, which consumes 5 points and can be selected repeatedly.
